verdict.rationale: Lindy itself publishes an llms.txt for its docs (confirmed via probe) and can be pointed at a hosted MCP server URL to gain tools/actions dynamically, which is conceptually adjacent to consuming agent-oriented docs. But there is no direct evidence that Lindy (as the agent) can be handed an arbitrary llms.txt file to ingest as context or tool definitions — the MCP-pointing capability is a different mechanism than llms.txt ingestion. Missing for 10: explicit support for feeding Lindy an llms.txt URL as a knowledge/tool source, and any documented workflow or example of doing so.
